Image 2 is the approved Sam identity and style master. Image 3 is the approved Max identity and style master. Image 4 is the actual original game context ONLY, to clarify identity and occlusion. Do not paint its scenery or other characters.
Redraw the entire single source cel together as one unified smooth cartoon painting on true transparent background. Keep all relative positions and source proportions. Resolve coarse pixel clusters into confident dark outlines, flat faithful colors with one shade and sparse highlights. Match the approved clean cartoon style without changing this source phase. Keep source head, hand and eye sizes, negative spaces and intentional clipping. No texture, dithering, glow, shadows, floor, scenery, labels or grid. Do not complete parts that are intentionally partial. Do not mirror, rotate, rearrange or invent details. Preserve every source-colored little detached fragment and mark. Each component must be painted as part of this single whole cel, never assembled from separately generated body parts.
Source-specific meaning and invariants: Exact whole BACK VIEW phase 1829. Lee-Harvey directly away, only brown-red quiff back and pink ears, no human face. Dark navy jacket/trousers with plain broad gray-blue shoulder/cuffs, narrow straight legs and long dark boots. Both raised arms hold Max horizontally behind/across human head: ears hang down-left in pink left grip, small cream head with tiny black eye peeks left of hair, middle body hidden, two cream feet upright at far right in right pink hand. Max upper-left arm is now extended diagonally UP-LEFT with an OPEN SPREAD PAW, not a clenched fist. Copy the exact source number of visible fingers, their individual lengths, bends and spacing; do not add fingers or make hand larger. Follow this 1829 shoulder/arm/foot position and hair outline exactly. No detached stars or effect strokes, no tail, belly button, new smile, extra pink pads, white eye ovals, Sam pieces or floor. Keep every original transparent gap and partial overlap, flat colors and clean source-faithful outlines, whole cel painted together.
The source palette controls the human: Lee-Harvey is a tall human thug with reddish-brown high quiff, pink skin, red shirt, nearly black/navy jacket and trousers, dark boots, blue-gray jacket edging. He is not Sam and not the blond man in the orange jacket. Max follows his approved cream fur, salmon inner ears, tiny black eyes and pink nose, but his expression, teeth, mouth and anatomy follow THIS source pose, not a generic master smile. Sam fragments, when present in Image 1, are blue-gray suit pieces of fallen Sam, not floor, a platform or boots. Only paint characters and partial pieces actually present in Image 1.
Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine soft antialiased alpha, no painted background. Maintain the whole original cel layout with generous transparent margin around and between all components, approximately the same framing as Image 1. Do not copy pixel stair steps or use a hard source silhouette mask. Frame costume124_1829, original complete extent 78 by 85 pixels. Every tiny gesture and attachment point belongs to this exact phase.
